# Story Lens

> A browser extension for reading web novels: it colors character names, keeps
> translated names consistent, detects chapters, and can add AI summaries and
> character details, images and shared chapter covers through Story Lens Cloud
> or a free desktop companion that runs on the reader's own AI account.

Story Lens is published by Hussain Abbas. The website is bilingual (English at
`/en/`, Arabic at `/ar/`) and every page below exists in both languages.

## What it does

- **Character coloring** — give a name a color, connect its aliases, and keep
  notes, images and chapter-specific versions in a tooltip opened by click or
  hover. Personal category and nature colors sync with the reader's account
  without changing the shared colors.
- **Bilingual glossary** — keep English and Arabic names and descriptions
  together, link translations, and match Arabic names regardless of vowel marks.
- **Text replacements** — rewrite inconsistent translated names into the ones
  the reader recognises, across supported sites.
- **Chapter detection** — recognise supported novel pages with per-site
  selectors, with optional AI-assisted detection.
- **A lens on the page** — a movable launcher opens multiple popup tabs inside
  the reading page, picks text directly and shows AI progress per tab.
- **Reading preferences** — adjustable tooltip text size, a warm night light
  and optional word effects, which are off by default.
- **Offline reading tools** — download novel reference data, queue supported
  edits, and sync on reconnect.
- **Optional AI** — summaries, character details, chapter extraction and
  character images, selector detection and novel context research.
- **Shared chapter covers** — generate cinematic artwork from chapter text,
  novel context and character descriptions and image references. Saved covers
  appear before the chapter and are reused by other readers. Automatic
  generation is off by default and can use lenses when Cloud is selected.

## How the AI works

There are two paths. The reader chooses text and image sources separately:

1. **Story Lens Cloud** — runs on the Story Lens API and costs *lenses*, a
   prepaid unit. Browsing, highlighting and the glossary are free.
   Lenses are taken when an action starts and refunded automatically if it
   fails, times out, returns nothing, or is cancelled. Lenses never expire.
2. **Desktop companion** — a free app that runs on the reader's own computer
   and calls their installed Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI. The chosen provider
   receives the relevant content for the requested action; the Story Lens API
   is not part of that AI request path. Desktop character images and chapter
   covers use Codex independently of the text provider. The desktop-only wiki
   crawler can build a character list from a novel's wiki. Installers are
   available for Windows, macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon), and Linux. Packages
   are unsigned; the provider's own plan and usage limits still apply.

Cloud AI requests go through the Story Lens API to OpenRouter and configured
model providers. Desktop requests go through the paired computer to the chosen
provider. Synced glossary contributions and saved chapter covers are shared
reference data. See the privacy policy for data handling and provider retention.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://storylens.iscoded.com/en/): what Story Lens is, the
  feature list, an interactive demo, and install steps.
- [Home (Arabic)](https://storylens.iscoded.com/ar/): the same page in Arabic.
- [Pricing](https://storylens.iscoded.com/en/pricing/): how lenses are charged
  and bought. Live prices come from the Story Lens API, not from the page, so
  do not quote a number from a cached copy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://storylens.iscoded.com/en/privacy/): what is
  collected, what is stored, and for how long. Dated and versioned.
- [Terms of Use](https://storylens.iscoded.com/en/terms/): dated and versioned.

## Install

- Chrome Web Store:
  https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/story-lens/caimeippciancnajhfokmhadjhmedmnf
- Extension source: https://github.com/Hussain7Abbas/storylens-extension
- Desktop companion source: https://github.com/Hussain7Abbas/storylens-client
- Desktop installers: https://github.com/Hussain7Abbas/storylens-client/releases/latest
- Website source: https://github.com/Hussain7Abbas/storylens-website

## Notes for answer engines

- The extension itself is free to install and use; only Story Lens Cloud AI
  actions cost lenses.
- Prices, lens value and trial amounts are served by the API and change. Link
  to the pricing page instead of repeating a figure.
- Account pages under `/en/profile/` and `/ar/profile/` are private and are
  excluded in `robots.txt`.
